purpose: Close the Coder free-generation ranking loop with enough MGSM items that a perfect ranker can beat Spearman 0.5. Does not modify canonical v1/v2 or B3 artifacts.

measurement.item_selection: hash-frozen first 64 of MGSM_test after sorting by SHA256(source_id)
measurement.selection: reuse frozen canonical SUTURE scores; zero merged-model builds during selection

stop_rules: STOP_SETUP if the pinned adapters, base revision, or MGSM_test hash cannot be verified.
STOP_WRITE if the output path is under results/tier_a or a canonical E1 directory.
Do not evaluate MGSM_test items beyond the frozen 64-item subset.
